places.name: Sikgaek Korean Restaurant and Bar
places.description: typical korean fare, west side in mississauga

places.name: شاورما حطب و نار Charc Shawarma
places.description: shawarma that comes recommended by many of the west FS folk

places.name: Yaseen’s Shawarma
places.description: iraqi style shawarma with the pink sauce. i thought it was pretty good! chicken is slightly on the drier side and imo could do with some more vegetables, but still a great option

places.name: Brandt Meat Manufacturing Plant & European Food Market Factory Outlet
places.description: this was one of my favourite places to come when i was at civic. little european grocery/butcher that has a hot table with sausages, schnitzel, cabbage rolls, etc. probably not the best if you are more than 3-4 people but i have always enjoyed lunch + some shopping. some nice items to take a look at that might be difficult to get at other grocery stores like weisswurst :)

places.name: Orda Uyghur Kebab
places.description: uyghur food, noodles, meat, etc.

places.name: Starsky Fine Foods
places.description: i have not been but i hear starsky is a great grocery store. unsure of how good their hot table is but i'd like to give it a go sometime

places.name: Blue Danube Sausage House Ltd.
places.description: tiny little butcher with a hot table that serves schnitzel and a rotating weekly menu. have not tried, but the sausages they make here are supposed to be really good as well

places.name: Pho Ngoc Yen Restaurant - Mississauga
places.description: one of two pho ngoc yen's in the area. both are roughly the same distance from the two TDSB ITS west buildings and probably about as good. while i thought it was good but not outstanding, it might be your best bet on this side of the city. a plus is that portions are very large

places.name: Angara Indian and Hakka Cuisine
places.description: indian and hakka

places.name: Palmyra Mediterranean House
places.description: family owned lebanese restaurant. shawarma, kebab, etc. would love to give this place a try sometime

places.name: Gus Tacos
places.description: popular toronto tacos chain that also does burritos, tortas, and quesadillas. haven't been to this location, but others have always been pretty good!

places.name: OBQ Burgers
places.description: another local burger spot

places.name: Congee Queen - Mississauga(Dundas&Hwy427)
places.description: andy amin and gave this a visit as our first lunch outing as a group, i think our selections could have been a little better but congee places like this are always going to be consistent, and only gets better as the group scales!!

places.name: Sanaa AlYemen Restaurant
places.description: yemeni food, i have never tried before but the reviews look promising!

places.name: FAT FORK
places.description: huge portions of greek food. amin seems to really like this place, and i thought it was pretty good too

places.name: PHO NGOC YEN 2 Etobicoke
places.description: the other pho ngoc yen location in this area. good pho!!!

places.name: IKEA Etobicoke
places.description: the etobicoke ikea. look for a discount on lunch meals, can be a fantastic deal!

places.name: Elijah's Automatic Flame Broiled
places.description: yet another burger spot to try :D

places.name: Ragu Scratch Pasta
places.description: have not tried but but i have heard so many great things about this place. locally owned italian pasta made from scratch. takeout only, but looks like it would be amazing if you're in the mood for pasta

places.name: Allwyn's Jerk (Etobicoke)
places.description: allwyns is a staple across the GTA, but tbh i have actually never had any patties from any location. i suggested we give this spot a go next time we want a snack for the office

places.name: Sanremo Bakery
places.description: well known etobicoke italian bakery. i have never ever happened to be in the area for this, so i am primed and ready to go if anyone else wants to come with me. i've been warned that as they have a massive selection of items, not everything is going to be a hit

places.name: Tom's Dairy Freeze
places.description: classic nostalgia-filled spot for ice creams and other diner-type foods. imagine what ice cream from an ice cream truck SHOULD taste like

places.name: Mamma Martino’s Restaurant
places.description: family run italian restaurant, amin's recommendation :) looks to be inexpensive and a popular local spot. also, right next to tom's dairy freeze for a post-lunch ice cream :D

places.name: Rancho Relaxo To Go Kipling
places.description: tacos, burritos, and quesadillas. this place sounds very nice, would like to give it a try sometime. they have vegan options as well as some weird options... not my cup of tea but maybe someone else's :p

places.name: Dimpflmeier Bakery
places.description: big bakery serving bread, pastries, and desserts. there's a nice coffee room to sit and eat in, if you're looking for something light, and to just chat over lunch

places.name: Fairouz Restaurant and Lounge
places.description: lebanese style kabob and other dishes. this place looks pretty fancy, maybe better for a special occasion

places.name: Yellow Cup Cafe
places.description: cafe and other cafe-foods across cloverdale mall

places.name: Mr. Souvlaki
places.description: greek spot at cloverdale mall, not bad actually, reminded me of when the NS team would get jimmy the greek from STC, taste was extremely similar

places.name: Thairoomgrand Etobicoke
places.description: it doesn't look like this thairoomgrand location has a lunch special, and while i have not been here before, these chains are normally very consistent. menu looks inexpensive, so it may worth a go!

places.name: Apache Burgers
places.description: OG burger spot with a special grape drink

places.name: Haroo Korean Restaurant 하루
places.description: i took greg, sham, and andy here. this is a new korean spot, seems family owned and very homey. idk what the other korean spots in the area are like, but i found it to be a little underwhelming compared to other places in korean hotspots (not that anything tasted bad, by any means!!)

places.name: Ikkoi Sushi & Ramen Japanese Cuisine
places.description: recommended by kevin chau, he said that the group used to go from time to time for sushi, ramen, and other japanese items

places.name: Blooming Batter (Formerly Stacks Toronto)
places.description: brunch food, if you're ever in the mood for that! bacon and eggs, sandwiches, pancakes, etc.

places.name: Curry and Chutney By Gopal's
places.description: local recommended spot for vada pav, masala dosa, pav bhaji, thali, etc.

places.name: Tropical South by the Cuban Thing
places.description: idk if this place actually exists or not but apparently its a food truck serving cuban style food. it looks really good but it might not even be a thing

places.name: McNie's Fish & Chips
places.description: fish and chips by martingrove and burnhamthorpe. supposed to be not bad! apparently they even used to serve haggis, but no longer. they've got a cod and chips + drink lunch special as well. honestly fish and chips is a pretty terrible lunch food imo (food coma) but on the rare occasion there is a craving, there is a spot

places.name: Lezzet Shawarma Falafel House
places.description: SO FAR my favourite shawarma spot in the west. huge portion, tender meat, and a reasonable amount of rice, salad, sauce (which is what makes or breaks these sorts of restaurants for me). would recommend to get here earlier than later, as sometimes there is a bit of a line

places.name: Bravo Bistro
places.description: donny took us with ziggy and the others to this polish place. i liked it a lot! nofrills and the schnitzel seemed fresh

places.name: North of Brooklyn Pizzeria
places.description: toronto pizza chain, really good thin pizzas. 14" pizzas feed 2, 18' feeds 3. i really enjoy these sorts of "slightly-upscale chains" where the pricepoint is marginally higher than what you'd find at somewhere like pizza hut or pizza pizza, but the food i find is significantly higher quality

places.name: Banh Mi Ba Le
places.description: banh mi, really inexpensive and pretty good taste, but it's a bit of a drive west into missisauga. they have a good sized menu with other options that might be harder to find elsewhere like banh bao, banh xeo, banh cuon. the people who work there are not the most polite though lol

places.name: Adonis
places.description: local middle eastern chain grocery store based out of quebec, there's a hot table with shawarma and other foods like that. i don't think it's the best food but if you want to also go to the grocery store, it's an option

places.name: Chit Chaat
places.description: punjabi food, looks popular!

places.name: The Elmwood
places.description: i think i'd have to be in a very specific mood for this, but this is a spot known for chicken wings. apparently they are some of the best on this side of the city

places.name: NAAN KABOB
places.description: afghani style kabob, fast-food style place, but they cook everything fresh which is always nice

places.name: RUDY
places.description: great burger spot with many locations around. their specialty is smash burgers. have not tried this location before but im pretty sure it'll be good!!

places.name: Revolver Pizza Co.
places.description: some of the best pizza around! small chain

places.name: Xawaash
places.description: somali/mediterranean place that mohammed recommended, he said he likes the chicken mandi

places.name: Amma's Kitchen
places.description: little south indian shop right near BCI. henry said he used to go very frequently, i am a huge fan of this sort of food for breakfast, so i'd love to give it a try. unfortunately they only open at 10, which is a little late for breakfast on a workday

places.name: Old Mill Pastry & Deli
places.description: little balkan convenience store/cafe with some fresh food options. last time i tried a burek which was a tad bit too oily for my liking, but had a good taste. google reviews say they have a cevapi plate which is really good, but i did not see last time. would like to give it a try as it's right next door to civic

places.name: KarachiXpress
places.description: pakistani kabob place across from sherway gardens. place looks to be a little more upscale than your typical takeout place. maybe nice for a group lunch. both the (many) kababs and biryani come highly recommended

places.name: Dum Biryani
places.description: little takout-only dum biryani spot. no idea if this place is good or not but someone recommended it, and it looks very inexpensive

places.name: P Jay's Jamaican Take-Out
places.description: great jamaican food and patties :) little shop without much seating, but it's a quaint little plaza that isn't too busy, so if its a nice day, sitting outside is an option. reasonably close to both 140 and woodbine. i like the jerk pork and plantain a lot, but patties are also great

places.name: Great Fountain Fast Food
places.description: hawker style chinese food in a little mall by sheppard and midland. crazy amount of options, but not all are great... but still amazing variety and inexpensive

places.name: One2Snacks
places.description: donny-approved malay shop. takeout only, with long wait times. good to order ahead of time via phone. char kway teow was good, laksa ok. ask donnie for what he thinks is best :D

places.name: Floga Estiatorio and Event Space
places.description: fancier greek place, have not tried but environment, service, and food all look quite good :)

places.name: ACR Hot Roti & Doubles
places.description: trinidadian food and supposedly the best doubles in toronto!!

places.name: Patty Time
places.description: little patty shop south of thomson memorial park

places.name: St. Andrews Fish & Chips
places.description: i might be getting baited but i have heard this place has some really good fish and chips. i feel like every fish and chips spot i've ever tried here has just been an oily mess (and this place probably is) but on the off chance this is actually good it might be worth a go

places.name: Federick Restaurant
places.description: long standing chinese hakka food. big portions, inexpensive pricetags, lots of oil. not good if you're dieting but sometimes you need a plate of chili chicken

places.name: Canbe Foods Inc
places.description: recommended spot for samosas and other sri lankan/south indian snack

places.name: The Roti Hut
places.description: apparently this was a place that the telecom team enjoyed going to when they were out east. west indian roti, doubles, etc. mona's roti is also nearby, may be worth trying both out :) i have not been yet!

places.name: Francesca Italian Bakery & Delicatessen
places.description: have not been here but there is an italian bakery/deli across from the roti hut. looks to be very popular. would like to give it a go

places.name: Mona's Roti
places.description: little bit east of mccowan and sheppard, another west indian roti and doubles spot. i had it once and everything was very good, but i recommend against ordering bone-in (so much bone, so little meat!)

places.name: Babu Takeout And Catering
places.description: as a co-op student with the NS team, i frequently used to leave home early to grab breakfast (which i don't even normally eat!) from here. the breakfast combos are all great value and taste great, especially early in the morning when they are fresh. i especially love the medu vada

places.name: THG's Hot Chicken
places.description: fried chicken, sliders, fries, mac, etc. have not been but have been told this place is really good. probably good on a day where you know the afternoon is going to be uneventful as you'll probably need a nap later

places.name: Lucky Chinese Restaurant
places.description: another hakka chinese spot

places.name: Silver Spoon Warden
places.description: inexpensive and very popular pakistani spot for biryani, bbq, and other dishes

places.name: Montmartre Bakery
places.description: amazing little bakery for breads and pastries. super inexpensive but very tasty

places.name: Congee Queen
places.description: congee queen, good for bigger groups

places.name: Thairoomgrand York Mills
places.description: another thai spot at york mills and don mills, this place has a lunch special while chiang mai (which seems to be better liked) does not. seems like good value!

places.name: Darband Restaurant
places.description: amin recommended this spot, looks like they are well known for both their kaleh pacheh in addition to the other typical persian options

places.name: Chiang Mai York Mills
places.description: thai, short drive south of peanut plaza. this place is a little more fancy and has a brunch menu, which is a little crazy to me lol (kind of a thai-western fusion, even more so than western thai food already is)

places.name: IKEA North York
places.description: ikea lunch :) they might have some discounts on some days, worth giving it a look

places.name: Som Tum Jinda - Fairview Mall
places.description: newer som tum jinda location in fairview mall; other locations come very highly reviewed. thai food

places.name: Bingz Crispy Burger Fairview Mall
places.description: this place has opened up a lot of locations recently, little crispy chinese "crepes" with meat filling + other small dishes. i don't mind this sort of food but it can be a little one-dimensional

places.name: Good Catch Cafe (Fairview Mall)
places.description: hong kong cafe specialties like cantonese baked casseroles, tea, and other small dishes. this place opened pretty recently in fairview mall and while the reviews don't look especially promising, i think it's worth a try :)

places.name: Molly Tea (CF Fairview Mall)
places.description: popular premium chinese tea shop, 3rd toronto location opened up in fairview mall. expect a line, but if you're already nearby, might be worth a try :)

places.name: ON HING BBQ
places.description: andy and i gave this place in peanut plaza a try, i thought it was above average compared to other cantonese bbq spots, and was very inexpensive

places.name: Allan’s Pastry Shop
places.description: authorized reseller of allan's jamaican pastries located right in peanut plaza, have not tried yet but would be a very easy way to get some snacks for the team

places.name: Saigon Express Restaurant
places.description: little viet/chinese/thai place inside the peanut plaza mall, i found the pho to be ok but a little too oily for my liking. other options look good and is inexpensive

places.name: Shi MiaoDao (Ten Seconds) Yunnan Rice Noodle (NorthYork) 十秒到云南过桥米线
places.description: yunnan style rice noodles, looks like plenty of options, quick service

places.name: Congee Wong
places.description: congee, cantonese dishes, and a big menu at finch and leslie. i have not been to this location but congee places like this are always pretty consistent and good

places.name: Lavash Authentic Armenian Restaurant
places.description: seems like a place you'd only come to if you had a little extra time. armenian/middle eastern food; not a lot of places serving some of these dishes, so worth a go if there is a day you're wanting a "long lunch" at

places.name: John Anderson's Hamburgers
places.description: burger shop at victoria park and finch, no seating inside but probably nice to eat on a "reasonable weather" day outside

places.name: Restaurant Boustan
places.description: the famous montreal shawarma in the GTA. i have not been to this location, but i have been wanting to give it a go (just not had a good opportunity)

places.name: T&T Supermarket Fairview Mall Store
places.description: fairview mall t&t location. good spot for grocery, snacks, bakery, and hot table
